notes.title: Pavel's story- part 1
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Survivors![/b][/h1][p]With this post, I’d like to kick off a short series about the lore of [b]Survival Machine[/b]. You’ve been asking us here on Steam and over on [url="https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8"]our Discord[/url] – how did it all begin? Where did the giant machines come from, and what led to the great apocalypse that turned most of humanity into zombies? [/p][p][b]Well, you're about to find out! Let me tell you a story… Pavel's story.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]….[/p][p]Since childhood, Piotr and I believed that one day we would change the fate of humanity. That dream kept us alive through hunger and poverty. Together, we swore we would create something greater than ourselves – a work that would outlive the ages.[/p][p]We shared the same dream: to ease the lives of ordinary people. That was our goal, our life’s calling. We supported each other deeply, and our brotherly rivalry drove us forward – even though we chose different paths.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/344be6f397c3e17bbc2f1b38e000bd85b3db41fa.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I was always fascinated by gears, transmissions, engines – the hidden rhythm that could bring lifeless metal into motion. Mechanics was the obvious choice for me. The louder and more complex something was, the more it drew me in. Piotr, always standing slightly apart, found his passion in alchemy – a young and not yet fully understood science, brimming with potential.[/p][p]For a long time, we were inseparable – brothers and co-creators, two halves of the same dream. We were going to change the world together. And it was to become reality, though not in a way I could ever have imagined. But I am getting ahead of myself… [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/65c6dc14d2a73065440cbcf28fd70d8ec9dc03aa.png"][/img][/p][p]After years of study, I was finally ready to fulfill the promise I had made to my brother and to myself – I would create something that could change humanity. Piotr still stood by my side, though for some time we had not been as close as in our childhood.[/p][p][b]The Moving Factory Machine[/b] – it was beautiful! Vast and thunderous! Because I equipped it with its own drive, it could cross entire continents and reach people left behind by the relentless march of civilization. Soon, it was given the name [i]Survival Machine,[/i] but it was far more than just a tool to make survival easier. It gave people hope for a better tomorrow.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/71e41cf256c576f3bad42c671de0652fcf33ebd3.png"][/img]I won’t deny it – the name flattered my vanity. It was pleasant to hear songs at local fairs, praising the Machine and its inventor. Yet I had only one problem: Piotr was drifting farther and farther away from me. He came to me less often for advice, we discussed our ideas more rarely, and his voice grew quieter whenever the songs about the Machine were sung. In his eyes I saw a shadow I could not name. Pride, but also anger. Joy, but also resentment. I fear that envy had taken hold of him.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/57371e51e28eefd0025245daa4d126d123165c10.jpg"][/img]And then, one day, Piotr simply disappeared. I have no contact with him, and I don’t know what happened. I only hope he hasn’t gone off chasing one of his “[i]creative[/i]” ideas. We always managed to find common ground, and my rational arguments usually reached him. But now he is out there, completely alone. And I fear for him.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thus begins the tale of a world where technology intertwines with desperation. The world of [b]Survival Machine[/b] – a land of colossal, wandering machines and fraternal rivalry. I hope you enjoyed Pavel's story, I already have a plan for its continuation! You can help me shape it—[url="https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8"]join us on our Discord[/url], where I’ll be happy to chat about how the brothers’ story could continue.  [/p][p]Have a great weekend![/p][p]Dzięki![/p][p]Berdol[/p][p]

notes.title: Content Preview - Meet the Zombieburg!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Survivors![/h1][p]You already know quite a lot about the upcoming Alpine Biome, but so far I haven’t mentioned a single word about the gameplay novelties we’re preparing for you. With this post I’d like to change that. Let me introduce you to Doctor Zombiestein and his flying fortress Zombieburg.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/5b9cf63d669e9308a3ee2c309808fb25906be3e0.gif"][/img][/p][p]I’d like to tell you the story of Zombiestein a little later – we’ll still have some time for that – but for now I want to show you the results of the last few weeks of work. Let’s go![/p][h2]1.Introduction to Zombieburg[/h2][p]The powerful mobile fortress of Zombiestein not only flies, but also shoots! Be careful, because although at first glance Zombieburg may look slow and clumsy, don’t be fooled by appearances! Zombiestein, a brilliant though slightly mad scientist, has prepared well for a possible encounter with Survivors![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/456c1a4e1dd748c435b9598080db49b9186a934b.gif"][/img][/p][p]His machine is equipped with the latest technological marvels. It even has a rocket engine that gives it unprecedented speed, and it is armed with powerful cannons capable of easily sweeping away everything you’ve been so carefully building on the Machine.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/ce39816a1cbde0b145ed90be5b75d46b5a073e03.gif"][/img][/p][p]Zombieburg hunts both during the day and at night, and it’s very hard to hide from it. Nothing is able to conceal you from its sight, and when a shadow suddenly covers the sun or the moon, look up at the sky and get ready to fight![/p][p]And how to fight it? Defensive turrets will definitely come in handy – they will be your main weapon against Zombieburg, although you can also damage it using ranged handheld weapons. It’s certainly not as effective as cannons, but every reasonable Survivor will fire at the incoming monster with whatever they’ve got![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/9ae23e4aafbe9ef0ac65acf23e4d74b8d05b3103.gif"][/img][/p][p]Fortunately, Zombieburg is not indestructible, but even when damaged it still has a few tricks up its sleeve. For now, I won’t reveal anything more 🙂[/p][p]One last thing: [b]we plan to adjust Zombieburg and the difficulty of the fight to the number of players in the session.[/b] Solo players will face a slightly easier challenge than a team of four Survivors. But I’ll tell you more about that in detail in my next post![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/80aff4fad02a158cea09efa73d79807be9575559.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]2. Wrap up![/h2][p]Zombieburg is not available in the game yet, but we can’t wait for you to encounter Zombiestein and his airborne vehicle for the first time. We’ve already run some short tests and it looks very promising, but you’ll unfortunately have to wait a bit longer for more details.[/p][p]But even now I can ask you – what else should such a massive zombie airship be able to do? I’d love to hear your ideas here in the comments or on [url="https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8"]our Discord[/url], to which I warmly invite you![/p][p]Thanks for being with us, Survivors![/p][p]See you soon!
Berdol[/p][p]

notes.title: Content Preview - meet the Mines!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey Survivors![/h1]

What's up, everyone? It's Dawid here! Time for another blog post, and this time we're diving deeper into the Alpine Biome to explore the Mines! Get ready for some gritty, industrial vibes packed with mysteries and challenges.  In this post I’m focusing on the world, while news about the gameplay itself we’re saving for another time.

[b]One important note:[/b] we’re still working on the Mines as part of the larger Alpine Biome. Our plan is for you to be able to step into the Alpine Biome for the first time [b]this winter[/b]. Here’s what’s coming your way:
[h2]1. The Mines: what to exect?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/5e55a89cf3e442263ebd107c5b4ae52f58eb0e1e.png[/img]
The Mines are a place where hard work meets a raw, industrial atmosphere. Unlike the sprawling hills of the Valley, here we descend deep into the dark, vast mine shafts. This area was once a bustling hub of extraction, primarily focused on mining metal ore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/9937e12e5b62daae0273422292b4bd1b0301ce9b.png[/img]
An entire industry sprang up around the mines, with its heart being an old sorting facility responsible for separating ore from waste. As a result, you'll encounter plenty of now-defunct conveyor belts and transport systems, which you can use to reach less obvious spots ([i]and trust me, it's worth exploring them, as that's where the most exciting rewards await you[/i]).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/5479f171678bc957ac27071c8510fd56c45e4a94.png[/img]
[h2]2. Challenges for Players[/h2]
And of course, what would the Alpine Biome and Mines be without some serious challenges! I won’t spill all the secrets we have planned just yet—this time, I’m focusing solely on the challenges awaiting you in the Mines. But rest assured, we’ve got plenty more gameplay surprises up our sleeves for later!

In the Mines, we want to get those brain gears turning. Expect a hefty dose of puzzles to solve, including tinkering with broken mechanisms left behind from the once-thriving industrial operations. Restoring these to working order will make navigating the mines a whole lot easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/dd1e9ab716191d4d64a7d4d449cc3f08b70628a3.png[/img]
And what about underground? Multi-level mine shafts await—each level brings a fresh challenge and a unique puzzle. Reaching the next floor will demand cunning, precision, and thorough exploration, as I’ve hidden plenty of secrets throughout the mines. Here’s a little hint: keep an eye out for concealed detonators—things are going to get explosive! 💥

One final teaser—I’m really excited to see your reactions when you reach the very bottom of the mines. I’ll hold off on revealing more for now, but let’s just say the team internally calls this part of the map “[i]our Moria[/i]”. 😏
[h2]3. Wrap up![/h2]
I can’t wait for you to plunge into the darkness of the Mines and uncover their secrets! Drop your thoughts in the comments—what are your guesses, and what excites you most about this segment or Alpine biome as a whole? 

It’s going to be a hot winter Survivors! [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]Keep an eye on our Discord[/url] and Steam, as that’s where we’ll let you know when the new content becomes available! See you underground! ⛏️

Dzięki!

notes.title: Discover the Alpine Biome - meet the Valley!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi Survivors,[/h1]
We hope you’ve been enjoying the latest updates – the team put a lot of heart into them! But today’s post is about something else. Today, I’d like to continue our journey through the Alpine Biome with you. You’ve already [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1601330/view/533228283922222767]learned a bit about the Frozen Bridge[/url], and in this entry, you’ll find out more about [b]the Valley[/b].

[h2]Valley – what can you expect?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/21531f08f2389828a32845e390a3902dc6a4ec11.png[/img]
Just like in Frozen Bridge, the people of Valley were used to hard, physical labor. The locals worked primarily in fishing, using the same bay where ships would arrive to collect lumber. It wasn’t easy work – the constant cold and harsh living conditions didn’t make life simple for the Valley’s inhabitants.

And yet, those working on the boats could consider themselves the “lucky ones.” The alternative was working in the local quarries, known for their beautiful stone that was often used as building material. 

As you explore the Valley, you’ll definitely come across the remnants of both fishing villages and stonemason camps. Today, of course, they’re abandoned – but not entirely empty. Every Survivor will want to check them out to see if anything useful was left behind for the journey ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/bc4a5ddef9a6517c01e6be76085f6017fc9fa9a7.png[/img]
There’s another important element you’ll find in the Valley: the remains of forts, apparently [b]built after the zombie apocalypse[/b]. The local people sought shelter high in the mountains, building fortifications meant to protect them from the ever-hungry zombies.
 
Whether they managed to hold out, or if they eventually left and headed – like you – toward the last bastion of humanity, we don’t know. The place is deserted and shows no signs of recent human activity, but you're sure to find something there that can aid you on your way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/be701d58b36cb822d2ba2c4c94adf5c96e1d7596.png[/img]
[h2]The Terrain[/h2]
Here’s where the real mountains begin. While Frozen Bridge was hilly, the Valley is made up of truly high peaks. I’m preparing a serious challenge for you when it comes to navigating this area – get ready to think creatively, as not every place will be reachable on foot. Some will require the use of a glider. All I’ll say is – it’s worth exploring the Valley thoroughly. I’m sure the rewards waiting for you won’t disappoint.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/079a8d2b1bb03c5daadc1462ad03de8831acfac6.png[/img]
Sometimes, one wrong jump might mean you’ll need to start your entire climb over again. The mountains are unforgiving, though luckily, there’s no fall damage in Survival Machine, so the only consequence will be the need to climb again. So be careful when jumping across ravines!

But the Valley isn’t just tall mountains – it’s also home to kilometers of underground tunnels found across almost the entire map. Not all the caves were known to the local population; some remain undiscovered to this day, just waiting for someone to find them. [b]Be warned though[/b] – caves can turn into real labyrinths, and getting out might be tricky. Keep that in mind when you head into the underground :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/892764d0dda9a5b2885f706ef7ffe446a719e8ac.png[/img]
[h3]Wrap up[/h3]
I hope you’ll enjoy everything Valley has to offer! If you have any feedback or ideas, feel free to drop a comment here or share them [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD]on our Discord[/url] – we’re always around to answer your questions :)

In the meantime, I’m heading back to work – there are still a few puzzles left to design. Thanks for reading, and see you in the next post!

cheers!
Dawid

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 is live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi Survivors![/h1][p]
[h2]🎉 Our first Major Update is now live on Steam![/h2]

This marks another big milestone for us — and for you, it means a whole lot of fixes and improvements across the board!
We’ve touched on many aspects of the game, including further optimization tweaks, full gamepad support, the ability to change the UI keybinds, and of course... [b]the long-promised Tommy Gun![/b]

So what exactly is changing in Survival Machine starting today? Check out the full patch notes below! 👇
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🌟 Major Additions[/h3] [list][*] 📌 Improved early quest flow to visit a POI (Points of Interest) earlier.
[*] 🏗️ Changed costs on building elements to be more accessible.
[*]  🔒 Building menu will now show locked items.
[*]  🎮 Added full-gamepad support. [b]We reached GOLD![/b]
[*]  🎀 Added multiple nice decorations to build. Decorations now provide additional storage space on the Machine.
[*]  🔫 Added Tommy Gun, can be found in legendary chests after mid-game phase.
[*]  🖱️ Players can now change UI keybinds
[*]  🚀 Major optimization improvements
[/list]
[hr][/hr][h3]🧱 Collision & Environment Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]  Several cockpit assets (chairs, tables, railings, floors) have corrected collisions.
[*]  Walls can now be used for hanging objects on both sides without restrictions.
[*]  Corrected lack of collision on Factory platforms and Windmill platforms.
[*]  Fixed areas where players could fall through the map in Cemetery Medium and Oil Rig Easy.
[*]  Resolved issues with objects and terrain causing players to get stuck under or inside geometry.
[*]  Removed invisible collision barriers blocking player interaction at multiple POIs (Points of Interest).[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🎮 Gameplay & Functional Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]  Fixed bug preventing players from starting a new game using Game Pad.
[*]  Players can place two roofs adjacent to each other where previously restricted.
[*]  Fixed active reload mechanic failing to work properly in co-op mode.
[*]  Addressed crafting bugs where clicking "Craft 5" would craft only once, and crafting would trigger outside valid UI bounds.
[*]  Fixed weapon shooting freeze and hotbar locking issues.
[*]  Fixed player getting stuck on ladders, platforms, and drivable vehicles.
[*]  Corrected issue where players could open certain chests from invalid positions or from underneath.
[*]  Resolved players stuck in the permanent options menu if the menu was open at death.
[*]  Fixed quest progression bugs including “destroy the zombie fort” marker visibility and “move the Machine” quest not completing.
[*]  Corrected issue where blueprints and autosaves overlapped causing game freezes.
[*]  Fixed problems with multiplayer hot join and item duplication blocking inventory and building[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🖼️ Visual & UI Fixes[/h3] 
[list][*] Added proper glowing effects on all buildable objects.
[*]  Fixed misplaced UI elements such as task UI overlapping inventory UI and shifted build UI arrows.
[*]  Fixed language switching updating button labels correctly.
[*]  Added options to turn off automatic saves and improved control mapping responsiveness.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🚀 Performance & Stability[/h3]
[list][*]  Eliminated infinite loading screens on multiple save states.
[*]  Resolved crashes caused by overlapping autosave events and corrupted player files.
[*]  Fixed softlock issues on Factory and Oil Rig levels.
[*]  Corrected rotation and spawn position bugs on Oil Rig platforms.
[*]  Improved machine building synchronization between clients in multiplayer.
[*]  Fixed player model disappearing during skin changes at stations.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🌐 Localization & Accessibility[/h3]
[list][*] Corrected Polish translation errors (e.g., “kick” action).
[*]  Fixed several scattered UI text fragments in Japanese and Traditional Chinese.
[*]  Updated accessibility features including keybind changes and controller sensitivity splitting.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🧩 Miscellaneous[/h3][p] Removed offensive NPC name to respect all players.
 [list][*] Added day counter to the game HUD.
[*]  Fixed various POI-related bugs including hidden or invisible levers and disabled zipline usage after updates.
[*]  Improved build menu usability.
[*]  Fixed bugs where dropped items on machines were uninteractive.
[*]  Adjusted environment LOD transitions to prevent aggressive quality changes.
[*]  Fixed problems with quest task display on older save files.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]👋 As always, we’re looking forward to hearing your feedback after the update![/h3]
We’ve done our best to make sure everything works as it should, but if you run into any issues or bugs, please let us know — either on [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]our Discord[/url] or right here in the comments below. 

[b]Oh, and the bug reporter - use it in any case![/b] Don’t forget to write a few words about the issue you’re having in the text area - it helps us understand and find the bug much, much quicker! 

Thank you for being with us — your support and activity mean the world to the team!

[b]Have a great weekend, Survivors! [/b]
Dzięki 
Berdol

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 – All You Need to Know!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi Survivors! [/h1][p]Today, I’d like to give you a little sneak peek of what we’ve been working on for Update 0.3.0, launching in just a week![/p][p]As always, we’ve put a lot of love and effort into this update, and we can’t wait to hear what you think about the new improvements coming to Survival Machine. Here's a quick look at what we've been up to in the past few weeks:[/p][list][*][p][b]🔧 Optimization – [/b]smoother and more stable gameplay[/p][/*][*][p][b] 🔫 Tommy Gun –[/b] a brand new weapon is coming your way! [/p][/*][*][p][b]🏗️  Building System – [/b]faster, more precise, and with new possibilities![/p][/*][*][p][b] 🎮 Gamepad Support & Auto-Aim – [/b]play your way, with enhanced aiming support[/p][/*][*][p][b] 🖱️  Customizable Controls in UI –  [/b]full key rebind options![/p][/*][/list][h2]
🔧 Optimization[/h2][p]We know this has been one of our bigger pain points, but also one of our top priorities. With the release of Update 0.3.0, you should notice a significant improvement in this area — we’ve put a lot of effort into it![/p][p]Alongside several smaller and larger changes, there’s one worth highlighting: starting with Update 0.3.0 , [b]the game will automatically suggest settings tailored to your PC’s capabilities[/b]. Of course, you're still free to manually adjust these settings if you prefer.[/p][p]However, we can’t move forward without you — we need your feedback on any issues you encounter. Update 0.3.0  definitely doesn’t mark the end of our optimization efforts, and the more input we get from you, the faster and more accurately we can keep improving![/p][p][/p][h2][b]🔫 [/b]Tommy Gun[/h2][p][b]We made a promise? We sure did! And now we’re delivering![/b][/p][p]A weapon ahead of its time — the pinnacle of military technology — is waiting for you just around the corner. A 20-round magazine and incredible rate of fire make it the perfect tool for taking on larger hordes of zombies. Few will be able to break through the wall of lead that Tommy unleashes.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/09bcaa6e9ca272f1bb110e38050122a1de9f8467.png"][/img][i]Pew pew pew pew!![/i][/p][p][b]You won’t be able to craft Tommy yourself at one of our workshops[/b] — to wield it, you’ll have to leave the safety of the Machine and head out to explore the world. Somewhere out there, hidden in one of the scattered crates, Tommy is waiting to be found.[/p][p]But fair warning — don’t go looking for Tommy right at the start of the game. We’ve planned for it to appear a bit later, as you progress through your journey.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🏗️ Building System[/b][/h2][p]We had to take a step back and rethink the direction we want to take when it comes to building in our game. I'm talking about the vibe we want you to feel when constructing new structures and decorating your homes.[/p][p]It feels like it’s time to give this aspect a clearer, more defined direction — and that’s exactly what the upcoming changes in Update 0.3.0  aim to deliver.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/c0ce51c965ed09ed9e1058617cc3d96f67d170a7.png"][/img][i]Let there be light![/i][/p][h3]Decorations will be getting a theme[/h3][p]Survival Machine is all about the journey the player takes alongside their Machine. We wanted that theme to be reflected in our building system as well. That’s why we’re aiming for the new decorations to capture that same atmosphere.[/p][p]Our idea? Something along the lines of a traveler’s living workshop. What do you think?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/404ad554421e4e0b3d53a60081d82ccd674d88ab.png"][/img][i]The number of pipes needed to keep the Machine running is measured in miles — sometimes they even spill out from the deck![/i][/p][p]We want our decorative elements to fit well with the theme of the road that runs through our game. That’s why you’ll find trophies you’ve earned along the way, reminders of your journey.[/p][p]We also want to showcase the last remnants of luxury items humanity managed to create before the zombie apocalypse. And of course, there’ll be countless bits and pieces every traveler carries — things collected along the way that [i]might[/i] come in handy... someday.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/990f362b0ce7f9b38f747408f6f6c1331949b258.png"][/img][i]Your very own botanical garden[/i][/p][h3]Changes to the models[/h3][p]In addition to new features, we’ll also be making several improvements to things you’re already seeing in [i]Survival Machine[/i]. We’ve started reworking some of the models to better match the vibe I mentioned earlier. I won’t reveal all the details just yet, but take a look at the bed, for example. Before the changes, it looked like this:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/013fb888af242928439d005a0a930057afdd7761.png"][/img][/p][p]And after the changes, we’re proposing this look:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/1444f81d72cbf3b08bdf3fb7105d96dd515073ab.png"][/img][/p][p]What do you think?[/p][h3]Decorations increase storage[/h3][p]No, of course not all decorations will increase the item storage limit on the Machine. However, we felt that what currently serves as storage isn't sufficient — and not entirely logical either. After all, a wardrobe should have that function too, don’t you think?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/933f909656b53f64d3d07f95036b97cca5199412.png"][/img][i]No, the new wall clock won't increase your storage limit, but it looks pretty cool![/i][/p][h3]Building will be cheaper, and decorating less complicated![/h3][p]A lot of feedback was focused on this aspect. You mentioned that sometimes you don’t feel like hunting down recipes for decorations. We understand that, and we’d like to propose some changes here: while some of the best and most interesting decorative elements will still require finding recipes (so it doesn’t get too easy), we’ve significantly simplified the decoration process for your Machine.[/p][p]This way, everyone can quickly create a beast they can identify with, and more importantly — one that they enjoy building and traveling with to the last bastion of humanity.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🎮 Gamepad Support & Auto-Aim[/b][/h2][p]In the previous update, we introduced the beta support for controllers. Based on your feedback, it seems that this control method is working well, and we haven’t received any major issues from you regarding its performance. And that’s great! [/p][p][b]With Update 0.3.0, we want to introduce an additional feature — auto-aim.[/b] Once again, just like with the controller support, we kindly ask for your feedback. Let us know how you think the auto-aim is working and where there’s room for improvement.[/p][p][b]Important note:[/b] if you’re not a fan of this feature, you can always turn it off by selecting the appropriate option in the settings.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🖱️ Customizable Controls in UI [/b][/h2][p]Another important feature that many of you, especially left-handed players, have mentioned. With next week's patch, you will gain the ability to customize your key bindings to suit your individual needs. We hope this change will make your gaming experience more comfortable![/p][p]However, if any issues arise, please make sure to let us know — whether it's in the comments on Steam under this post or by [url="https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8"]reaching out to us on our Discord[/url].[/p][p]We’d like to ask you to share your feedback on what accessibility options you think we should add. We’re aware that some players may have disabilities, so your input will be valuable in making the game more inclusive for everyone![/p][p][/p][h2]📦 [b]Wrap-Up[/b][/h2][p]That’s all for the sneak peek at [b]next week’s Update 0.3.0[/b]! We hope the changes we’re making will make the game more enjoyable for you. As always, we’re counting on your feedback – it means a lot to us![/p][p]Thanks for being with us, and we hope you have many fun and exciting evenings ahead with Survival Machine.[/p][p]Until next time! Dzięki![/p][p]Berdol

notes.title: Discover the Alpine Biome!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi Survivors, [/h2][p]I’m Dawid, and I’m a level designer at Survival Machine. Before I get to the point, let me say a few words about myself. I studied Computer Science in Wrocław where I also began my journey in game development. Besides creating games, I’m passionate about football and major events like the Euro and the World Cup. My second passion is cars — I absolutely love sports cars! On warm days, I enjoy going on bike trips, and in the evenings, I often spend time playing with my chinchilla, Nela. [/p][p]Today, I’d like to take you on a short trip to the snowy mountains and show you a bit of the world we’re preparing for you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/b2f0d4185aa33aa4cfdde99ee638e74e74a00276.png"][/img][/p][p]As you already know from Berdol's previous posts and our roadmap, we’re working hard on the next biome — the inaccessible and freezing Alpine. There’s still quite a bit of creative work ahead of us, but I’d already like to share the first results of what we’ve done so far.[/p][h3]What will Alpine be like?[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/4e4576e2c4feb5097b775d45038393b2cd01a502.png"][/img][/p][p]Life in the mountainous Alpine was not easy. Harsh weather and steep cliffs posed significant challenges for the local community involved in logging. And not just any wood, but the enormous sequoias that, thanks to the unique microclimate, grow in the alpine valleys. It was here that mountain streams would merge into a river, and the wood was then floated down to the nearby port, where cargo ships awaited loading. Unfortunately, one of these ships was in the port when a rockslide completely blocked the shipping channel, cutting the ship off from the open sea, trapping it there forever.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/a877ad3f7536031204380a759258ab08fa160b45.png"][/img][/p][p]Alpine will be quite different from Frontier, which you’re already very familiar with. While Frontier offers open spaces that are relatively easy to travel through, in Alpine, you’ll need to prepare for a lot more challenges. Canyons, valleys, towering peaks, and hidden caves won’t just treat you to stunning scenery — they’ll also be perfect places fo me to conceal secrets and stash loot crates. I encourage you to dive deep into our winter world, where exploration brings not only excitement and spectacular views, but also meaningful rewards for your dedication.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/a5dcd21df918648724250710cdc846f37443f1e8.png"][/img][/p][p]I’ve seen a lot of positive feedback about our PoIs, and when designing new puzzles and challenges for the Alpine Biome, I’d like to expand on the ideas from Frontier that you enjoyed the most.[/p][p]In the Alpine Biome, we want to challenge our Survivors. So, I’m preparing plenty of climbing and parkour elements for you. So far, in Frontier, you've mostly moved horizontally, but the Alpine biome will add vertical elements to the mix. What does that mean for you? Paragliding and zip lines scattered across the world will become your best friends when exploring this biome.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/77e76253a968c673bb789700515ce50bded6d6a2.png"][/img][/p][p]But! We won’t be relying solely on platforming elements; I’m also preparing various kinds of puzzles for you. Like the ones you'll encounter at our first roadblock, the bridge.  [/p][h3]Frozen bridge  [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/3cf0d60129029b32a4df553f2ea593296d921256.png"][/img][/p][p]The heavy drawbridge is one of the most important infrastructure elements in the Alpine biome. It allowed massive machines to cross over the river, which served as a transport corridor for the floating timber. Today, after the apocalypse, its mechanisms are neglected and frozen. The Survivors' task will be to unlock the bridge mechanisms and enable our Machine to continue its journey.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/f61f74bae6d2c73cb66bb1e4d0082dabad99238c.png"][/img][/p][p]To do this, you’ll need to activate special lights that were once used to thaw the bridge’s mechanisms. For the lights to work, they need to be powered. Unfortunately, the nearby power plant has long since stopped working, the passage to it is blocked, and the local power relays are damaged. [/p][p]I can assure you, it won’t be easy. I’m preparing several small challenges related to this roadblock for you. You’ll need dynamite and a sharp eye, but we’ll also test your memory with a code-entry challenge. But I’m giving away too much already — wait for the final result!

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0 is now available!
notes.notes: [h1][b]Hello Survivors![/b][/h1][p]Here comes Patch 0.2.0, which we’ve been working on over the past few weeks. It’s the result of your feedback and the needs you’ve so actively expressed in your reviews, discussions, and conversations on Discord. Thank you so much for your support and help with Survival Machine – without you, this patch wouldn’t be nearly as extensive! I hope the changes we’ve introduced will have a significant impact on how you experience Survival Machine and increase the enjoyment we want you to get from playing it. That’s enough of an introduction – let’s get into the details![/p][hr][/hr][h2]🚀 Highlights[/h2][list][*][p][b]Game-pad Support (Beta)[/b] - First iteration of game-pad support is live! Check the dedicated controller tab in Settings (we show Xbox tool-tips) and tell us how it feels. Auto-aim is planned for a future update.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Machine Collision Overhaul[/b] - Re-authored cockpit, ladder, pallet, front bumper, and railing colliders; prevents falling through, window-vaulting, and “air-walking” across the machine.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crash & Infinite-Load Fixes[/b] - Addressed the top-reported crashes and added an on-screen message for rare infinite-load cases.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Pass[/b] - Smarter render-distance swaps on quality presets, trimmed loading times, memory spikes, and GPU stalls on Low settings[/p][/*][*][p][b]Night Loot[/b] - Zombies now drop loot during nightly assaults, rewarding after-dark defence.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No Hard Game-Over[/b] - New Game-Lost flow: the night ends if all core components are destroyed—players must repair them before the machine can move on, but you can’t lose anymore.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weakpoint Visuals[/b] - Destroyed weakpoints now switch to a broken model for clearer feedback and less confusion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic Music Blend[/b] - Re-tuned soundtrack logic for smoother transitions between Default, Combat, and POI themes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Siege Frequency Balance[/b] - On Adventure & Survival difficulties, zombie siege nights now occur every three nights by default.[/p][/*][*][p][b]POI Variety Boost[/b] - New randomisation rules greatly reduce how often the same POI appears in a single run.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Detailed Patch Notes[/h2][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 Controls[/h3][list][*][p]Added full gamepad support with separate Xbox icons (beta). In the automatic setting, the game will detect whether you're using a gamepad or a mouse and keyboard. We've also left the option to choose mouse and keyboard only.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//40709796/4cf779fa6400379eb2d65e6d8b4295b16df97e84.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare input lock when spamming ESC in the key-bind window while confirming changes.[/p][/*][*][p]“Load Game” now highlights the most recent save, not the oldest.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🏗️ Machine & Level Geometry[/h3][list][*][p]Cockpit interior, windows, and front plate now block players correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched gaps in ladders, railings, furnace walkway, bridge, and several POIs—no more sneaking into the void.[/p][/*][*][p]Wheels no longer spin in place after the Machine stops at a blockage.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed watermark plank collision on the bridge; fixed floating barrel after green dynamite[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🌍 World, Quests & Interaction[/h3][list][*][p]New games always start on the Stream map before rolling into random order as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Zip-line: fixed an issue you drop early from the zip-line![/p][/*][*][p]Quest markers now clear correctly once the gate quest is finished.[/p][/*][*][p]“Player is full” tooltip shows only when you try to eat.[/p][/*][*][p]Added item sort-by-category and made Drop/Take-All respect that filter.[/p][/*][*][p]Weakpoints now swap to a destroyed mesh once broken.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented new PoI randomization rules so locations repeat far less often.[/p][/*][*][p]Night Loot: zombies now drop loot during nightly assaults.[/p][/*][*][p]Game-Lost rework: the night ends if all core components are destroyed; players must repair them before the machine can move on—total game-over is gone.[/p][/*][*][p]Polish to the repair UI and new construction VFX.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧟 AI & Enemies[/h3][list][*][p]Zombies no longer spawn or run mid-air; levitating hordes grounded.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed zombie pathing that let them climb machine ladders or breach secret gates unintentionally.[/p][/*][*][p]Zombie names are now synchronized for all players![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where zombies could stop reacting to players after extended sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced pursuit logic—zombies no longer chase forever once line-of-sight is broken.[/p][/*][*][p]On Easy and Medium difficulties, siege nights now occur every three nights by default.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📦 Multiplayer & Saves[/h3][list][*][p]Autosave stability greatly improved; [b]This is important:[/b] Survival Machine scales for both solo players and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1601330?emclan=103582791470231204&emgid=4481739601737678987]co-op[/url], so you don't need to worry about that. We've also prepared 3 difficulty levels, so each of you will find the one that suits your playstyle best. In solo mode, fighting zombies and managing the machine will be a bit easier than in co-op mode. We've got you covered, solo players!

[h2]Available languages[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/b8437d6926df354ca48114c6980538905e0c415f.png[/img]
Survivors come from every corner of the world, and we wanted to make sure you feel comfortable playing Survival Machine. Everyone enjoys the game more in their own language, so here they are:
[list][*] English(en) 
[*] Spanish(es) 
[*] Chinese(zh)

[*] French(fr)

[h2]The world - Introducing the Frontier and its challenges! [/h2]
You'll find yourself surrounded by wide, open spaces filled with trees and scenic views. The starting biome is designed as the perfect place to get familiar with how Survival Machine works. It’s where you’ll first come face-to-face with our zombies and take your initial steps into the grand adventure that lies ahead—right here in the Frontier. If you'd like to learn more details about Frontier, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1601330/view/4192363662378514590]feel free to check my previous post[/url], where you'll find all the answers!
[h3]Roadblocks[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/973a2f7fc4190dbef514b36fccfe23b4eb7863c2.gif[/img]
The Frontier will also present serious terrain challenges for the Machine—and without your help, it’s going nowhere. We’ve prepared a series of obstacles for you to tackle: [b]a landslide blocking the path, a collapsed bridge, a sealed gate, and even a fort set up by our zombies.[/b] Each of these will test you in different ways—whether it’s solving puzzles, using clever strategies, or proving your combat skills, you’ll need to rise to the occasion.
[h3]Points of Interest (PoI)[/h3]
Let’s not beat around the bush — in Early Access, we’ve prepared a whopping 34 unique Points of Interest (PoIs) which we’ve divided into three categories for you to discover. These are specially designed locations scattered across the map, each offering unique challenges. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1601330/view/4234028300457227038]More detailed information abour our PoIs's can be found here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/d81e7064097b64898f2171865d11517433e8c6fd.gif[/img]
Test your skills! Agility in platform-focused PoIs, combat in brutal arenas filled with zombies, and problem-solving in mind-bending puzzles. Each challenge offers a well-earned reward, but only the best will make it through. Prove you're the ultimate Survivor by mastering each test.
[h3]Secrets[/h3]
Oh yes, we’ve got secrets too. Hidden deep across the Frontier are secret spots and locations just waiting to be discovered. But don’t expect an easy ride — we made sure they’re well-hidden, and cracking them open will take some serious brainpower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/af8346ccc0139dbcb787bf988528aed21209d168.gif[/img]
For the most curious of you who manage to uncover them, legendary loot awaits! So dive into the Frontier and explore every corner — it’ll be worth it!
[h2]Equipment - what will you use and fight with![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/40ecf7d59922804ed3f402d64f2a5153cba5ffa6.gif[/img]
In Survival Machine, you’ll have access to a wide range of gear. We’ve prepared everything you need for exploration and resource gathering — from axes and pickaxes to hammers. But that’s not all.
[h3]Equipment Sets[/h3]
Survival Machine also features special equipment sets that give you a real edge. How to get them? Explore! In the Frontier you’ll be able to find few sets for you to use to your advantage:
[list][*] Woodcutter set increases the tool efficiency of every axe by +1
[*] Gravekeeper set helps when you die, because you don't lose the items in your backpack
[*] The Ironbound set makes the durability of all items decrease 50% slower
[*] The Shadowstep set makes dodging cost no stamina
[*] …and a few others, but I’ll leave their discovery up to you[/list]
[h2]Weapons and shields[/h2]
There is no true survival without various types of weapons, and in a scenario like ours, where the threat of a zombie attack is not only real but practically certain, weapons are simply a must. Same goes for shields, fighting zombies without any protection can be very difficult.

I won't describe everything here, but I would like to give you a taste of what's to come on May 7th.
[h3]Melee weapons[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Clubs[/b] are an easy-to-make weapon that, when using a heavy attack, can stun incoming zombies, giving you time to escape.
[*] [b]Swords[/b] work great against larger groups of zombies as they can deal area damage. Additionally, holding a sword in your hand gives you a good chance for a critical hit.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/8261a8c1f2c9b50a64d021305bc5e3e80da97e46.gif[/img]
[h3]Ranged weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]The slingshot[/b] is a small, unassuming weapon you'll first encounter in Survival Machine. It fires multiple projectiles at once and, in skilled hands, can thin out zombie hordes. In heavy attack mode, it can knock down zombies chasing us.
[*] [b]Bow[/b] is a more serious ranged weapon. It has a clearly greater range than the slingshot, allowing for relatively safe shooting from a distance. When using the heavy attack, an arrow shot from the bow is capable of piercing through several zombies at once.
[*] [b]Repeater Rifle[/b]. You’ve been waiting for this, haven’t you? Dominating in range and damage over more traditional ranged weapons, the Repeaters feature a six-round magazine, allowing you to take out zombies from a distance quickly.[/list]
Additionally, all firearms are equipped with a mechanism that significantly speeds up reloading, and if you’re good enough and hit a perfect reload, your weapon will get damage boost as well. You’ll see for yourselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/efb346010288de4ae03a8b66050f6b47f47f3450.gif[/img]
[h3]Shields[/h3]
Shields allow you to block more attacks, and each one has a unique effect on a perfect block. We have several options here. Some shields only stun the zombies on perfect blocks, others will restore a point of your health, and the best ones will also give your character a buff to the damage you deal. Certain shields also provide additional health or stamina points when equipped.
[h3]Artillery and traps[/h3]
We have quite a few heavy weapons in store for you! [b]The bomb thrower[/b] is a powerful artillery piece with a large calibre, designed to launch projectiles over long distances. [b]The light cannon[/b] is a more compact and lightweight version, with a smaller calibre. [b]The ballista[/b] offers ranged support on the battlefield, very handy during night attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/b3b8000d488d6b047f802ac787b48b7cb74152d4.gif[/img]

When the big guns aren't enough, [b]traps are your backup[/b]. We've designed a variety of them, but be mindful of your energy level – without it, your traps, which are your last line of defense, will become nothing more than a pile of scrap. Some traps will use spikes to slow down zombies, others will inflict fire damage, and some... well, you'll have to wait until May 7th to see what else we have in store.

[h1]Wrap up[/h1]

As you can see, there’s quite a lot to discover, and I bet it will take you some time to uncover everything! Remember, the Early Access launch doesn't mark the end of Survival Machine’s development — quite the opposite! It's just the beginning, and the game will evolve significantly by the time we reach version 1.0.

I emphasize this in almost every post — we need your feedback and involvement! Even now, your influence on how Survival Machine looks and feels is invaluable. The game wouldn't be where it is today without our amazing community. We warmly [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]invite you to join us on Discord and become part of it[/url]!

In the meantime, I’ll leave you with a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1601330/view/533222594185265462?l=english]reminder about our community challenge[/url], where your engagement can earn you a [b]20% discount on Survival Machine for the Early Access[/b] launch!

notes.title: We've got all the answers!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi Survivors! [/h1]

Recently, we asked you to send us your burning questions about Survival Machine and our work! We've gathered your questions from our Discord, social media, and Steam, and now we have the answers for you! No need to drag it out—let’s get started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/612cbefb813f7f75c2490db1266f4b48457345f0.png[/img]

[h3]Will widescreen be supported?[/h3]
[b]Yes![/b] Our goal is for Survival Machine to fully support widescreen. The current demo already supports 2560x1080 and 3440x1440, but if you have a non-standard resolution, let us know, and we’ll try to add support for it.

[h3]Will there be a pause in single-player?[/h3]
[b]Yes, single-player mode will have a pause function,[/b] but this feature is not yet working in the current demo.

[h3]Will there be a character editor in the game?[/h3]
No, but we will have several different characters to choose from, so everyone can find one that suits them. However, [b]you won’t be able to customize their appearance[/b].

[h3]Will there be enemies other than zombies?[/h3]
No, in Survival Machine, [b]you will only fight zombies[/b]. However, we plan to introduce many different types and variations of zombies in the future.

[h3]Are the worlds randomly generated?[/h3]
Survival Machine features [b]partially random world generation[/b]. The order in which you discover different parts of the world can change, and elements like POIs, resources, crates and more will be generated in different locations each time you play—so you’ll always find something new! 

[h3]Will inverted mouse controls be available?[/h3]
Yes! Inverted mouse controls [b]will be included[/b]. Our developers are working on adding this option right now.

[h3]Is the world infinite?[/h3]
The world is finite, [b]but with a twist.[/b] You shouldn’t be able to hit the end of the map. Instead, the game loads the next part of the world for you, making each session a little different

[h3]Will I be able to change the difficulty level?[/h3]
At the moment, [b]the demo does not include difficulty settings[/b]. However, we are actively considering implementing this feature in the future.

[h3]Can I move built structures?[/h3]
No, [b]once a structure is built, it cannot be moved[/b]. However, you can destroy it with a hammer and rebuild it in a new location. Destroying a structure returns all of the invested resources.

[h3]Will the game be playable on Steam Deck?[/h3]
We haven't fully explored this topic yet. Our goal is to officially support Steam Deck in the future, but for now, [b]there is no official support[/b]. That being said, you CAN already play the game on Steam Deck, but you might encounter some control issues.

[h3]Will control remapping be available?[/h3]
Yes, [b]you can already change key bindings[/b] in the current demo.

[h3]Will there be a matchmaking mode with random players?[/h3]
[b]Currently, this option is not available.[/b] We are operating on an invite-based system. We would like to add this feature in the future, but we can't make any promises at this time.

[h3]What is the recommended player count for the game?[/h3]
[b]There is no fixed number.[/b] You can play Survival Machine solo, in pairs, or in groups of three or four players. The game scales difficulty dynamically, so you can enjoy it no matter how many people are in your session.

[h3]Is there fall damage in the game?[/h3]
[b]No, you don’t have to worry about falling.[/b] Survival Machine has no fall damage—this makes gameplay smoother and more enjoyable!

[h3]Are you considering pricing the game lower, around $5-10?[/h3]
We are [b]not ruling out any pricing options[/b]. However, for now, we are aiming for a price range of $15 to $30.
[hr][/hr]
[b]Thats all for now Survivors! [/b]If you have any more questiones feel free to ask them here in the comments section, on [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]our Discord[/url] or in Steam Discussions.

Have an awesome weekend, and dont forget to try our demo!

In addition, we’ve got a little contest and one more surprise in store for you! Keep an eye on our Discord and Steam, and you’ll find out all the details!

[h3]Feedback - if you have one share one![/h3]

[b]Your opinion is very important to us.[/b] By leaving comments here on Steam or [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]on our Discord[/url], you've had a real impact on the development of the game. Many of your suggestions have been implemented, and we’re still working on others. We read and analyze all feedback carefully—there are no opinions that are unimportant to us. That’s why we kindly ask you to share your thoughts with us as widely as possible.

One of the preferred ways to share your feedback is to use our form. [url=https://forms.gle/thRNdSajpFZt4JZ4A]Here it is![/url]

[b]And most importantly – if you enjoyed our demo, please leave us a review on Steam.[/b] It’s a very important indicator for us of how you perceive our game and whether you’d recommend it to a friend for a co-op session! We’re counting on you!

That’s all I’ve prepared for you today. I hope you have a great time in Survival Machine! Watch out for those zombies—they might just eat you! See you next time!

notes.title: Coop - what to expect?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/bbafb51533b277aac73e2b7442f3aff67850d071.jpg[/img]
[h1]Coop - What Will It Be Like, and What Can You Expect?[/h1]

In today’s devlog, I’d like to share more details about the cooperative gameplay in both the early access version of Survival Machine and the later stages of development. Many of you have been asking about co-op on our Discord (if you haven’t joined yet, we encourage you to do so—there’s a link at the bottom of the page). 

I thought this would be a great opportunity to give you a dedicated space to ask questions and leave suggestions. Your feedback has been invaluable during the closed alpha and demo phases, and we’re eager to hear your thoughts on co-op as well.

[h3]The Basics: How Will It Work?[/h3]

In Survival Machine, you can enjoy the game solo, but for those who love playing with friends, we’re designing a cooperative mode for up to four players.

To keep things simple and player-driven, we’re using a peer-to-peer system instead of external servers. This means the host’s computer will manage the session.

Key Detail: At this time, we’re not planning to allow random matchmaking with strangers. You won’t be able to search for games with open slots and join them. Instead, we believe Survival Machine works best with an invite system, where players can choose who they want to play with.

To start a co-op session, you’ll invite your friends via our lobby—easy! The host generates a unique code in the game and shares it with their friends to join.

[h3]Saving the Game[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/45201ea1cd6d1bf7ef7867f736144c3ae3ad3cf1.jpg[/img]
Each player in a session can save progress using the book located on the Machine. However, [b]the save file is only stored on the host’s Machine[/b]. This means that if you wrap up a session and want to return later, only the host can load the saved world.

[h3]What Makes you stand out?[/h3]
Personalization! When joining a game, players can select one of several pre-designed characters, available in both male and female options. We’re working hard to offer a wide variety of distinctive designs so everyone can feel at home in their survival avatar.

[h3]Task Sharing[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/11d8b993b630f53d0ca6bcaa1c5999e2ad0761f9.jpg[/img]
In Survival Machine, players share one overarching goal: to reach the last bastion of humanity in a world overrun by zombies. But how you accomplish that is entirely up to you.

While completing story quests is a central part of the game, you’ll also need to manage tasks like maintaining the Machine, exploring, crafting, and gathering resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/dc805dbb12afc8522797a867f93af9cabe077d42.jpg[/img]
We’re leaving these decisions in your hands. You can choose to split tasks among your team or tackle everything together. For example, if one player loves crafting and another prefers tackling challenges at points of interest, that’s fine—there’s something for everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/94ffc3dfd6113fa44c3fa7d1a5d76ccda6f8c50c.jpg[/img]
[h3]Balancing the Game[/h3]
Balancing has been one of our main challenges. We want you to feel appropriately challenged, whether playing solo or with up to three friends. Based on your feedback from the demo, we know solo play can feel a bit overwhelming. Here’s how we’re addressing it:

Solo Play Adjustments:
[list][*] Fewer zombies to fight.
[*] Nighttime attacks will be less intense.
[*] Operating the Machine will require less fuel to move and power workstations.[/list]
Co-op Adjustments:
[list][*] The game will adapt to the combined levels of all players rather than matching the highest-level player.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/2edc27ba2cc2792b2f4ad066ca5c73452bfb1603.jpg[/img]
[h3]Inventory[/h3]
Each player will have their own personal inventory for items like melee weapons, shields, resources, tools, and powerful black powder firearms.

On the Machine, you’ll have shared storage. If you run out of space, you can build additional barrels or shelves to expand storage capacity. The shared inventory ensures everyone in the team has access to resources. Pretty neat, right?

[h1]Wrap up![/h1]
That's all for today! We hope you have an amazing time with our co-op mode! If you have any questions, feel free to drop them in the comments section here on Steam. For those interested, [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]join us on Discord[/url]! See you there! 👋
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1601330/Survival_Machine/]Dont forget to add us to your wishlist![/url]
Dzięki!

notes.title: It's all about Points of Interests!
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Machine Crew![/h1]

We've had a little break in our Devlogs; there's just too much going on, and we can't always keep up with everything. My bad, sorry! But! Smaller, weekly updates are still being posted on our [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]Discord[/url] - which we warmly invite you to join. But enough excuses - let's get on with the next Devlog. This time, I'd like you to learn more about our Points of Interest (referred to as PoI in the text).

What are our PoIs? They are some of the most interesting spots on our map, places that anyone serious about survival simply must visit. It could be an old abandoned farm or a cemetery.
Without PoIs, you won't progress further. Without PoIs, you won't obtain new upgrades for the machine; without exploring PoIs, you won't find the most valuable loot. And finally, without PoIs, you won't advance to the next biomes, and surely you want to reach the last bastion of humanity, right?

Especially since exploring PoIs is just plain fun. We've prepared several types of PoIs for you, each offering something different and requiring you to demonstrate knowledge of various mechanics we've designed for you. We're trying to create our world in a way that keeps things exciting, so even completing the game once won't mean you know everything about our map.

[h1] How to find PoI’s?[/h1]

If you read the previous Devlog, you know that our PoIs change their locations. Of course, you won't find PoIs walking around the map and changing their spots (that would be a bit strange, wouldn't it?). However, our world changes with each of your visits, and even if you saw metal or stone deposits in a certain area before, it doesn't mean they'll be there next time.

The same goes for PoIs; with each visit, you'll encounter different challenges in the same place. This way, we want to encourage you to explore the world and increase replayability, while also presenting you with new challenges.

I will repeat this endlessly - explore our world, visit the PoIs, and search them thoroughly. Although the zombie apocalypse has almost completely wiped out human civilization, you can still find things in its ruins that will greatly aid you in your adventure. People fleeing in panic left behind plenty of loot and interesting recipes, and it would be a shame not to make use of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/400be5dfeb9179678788a46a009b5194fdbc3f82.png[/img]

Especially since our Machine is equipped with sonar! I've described its functionality in previous blogs, but as a quick reminder: the sonar allows you to find loot and resources on the map.

It will also highlight the most important points on the map, including our PoIs, in which you should be interested in. That's where the most interesting and valuable loot will be waiting for you.

Thanks to the sonar, your team will easily find the places where the necessary resources are hidden, and a flare shot in the right direction will guide you and your companions straight to the spot. Use it extensively, but remember: the sonar only works when the Machine is operational!

[h1]Types of PoI[/h1]
I mentioned earlier in the post that we are preparing several types of PoIs for you. In one, you'll be able to demonstrate your combat skills; in another, you'll exercise your grey matter by solving puzzles, and in yet another, platform challenges will test your reflexes.

[h3]a) Arenas[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/7962f68abb16633e023889f6edc1e7ed767d1ce3.png[/img]
Here's where you can showcase your combat skills, and it's worth it because the reward will be significant! Once a lively, colorful festival, this place is now teeming with zombies eagerly awaiting their next meal - after all, humans are their favorite delicacy! Getting to the reward chest amidst these ravenous flesh-eaters won't be easy... Grab your weapon, dust off your shield, and prepare for battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/2e6f0e1a1183ccaf526127d4db08bd0a31b5960b.png[/img]
[h3]b) Platformers[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/1d4e66d86f5c372e4fc1057fde509c676f4fe432.png[/img]
Do you enjoy reaching where no survivor has gone before? Or perhaps you believe you're the best jumper, the fastest runner in the entire team? You can put that to the test by challenging your skills at one of our platform-based PoIs. If you prove skilled enough, a reward awaits you at the end of the road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/bdec643adf4f03e0d907e23afe27836f059fee98.png[/img]
[h3]c) Puzzles[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/7f9bfb11b28557ca702d17cda478413a919a04d4.png[/img]
A challenge for the brainiacs in your team! Anyone can swing a sword or wield a pickaxe, but solving these puzzles will require someone with a sharp mind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/41600b03c7a7705e7f28f8dc985c144e658be9d0.png[/img]
[h1]Variants of PoIs [/h1]

We have designed several types of Points of Interest to keep the exploration engaging and varied. Here are some of the main variants you will encounter:

[h3]a) Farm[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/8a885ec1f8ed97204cec80bf5b1e262d53621f8c.png[/img]
Depending on the variant, the player will need to demonstrate quick reflexes in platforming tasks, as well as cleverness in solving puzzles. In one variant of the Farm, the player will have to figure out a route to the reward and then prepare that route by moving... but you’ll discover that on your own. In another variant, to get the reward, the player will have to fill a tank with water. How? You'll find out everything in Survival Machine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/f160cab9379ea5b4bfd5def9660f2aa58e92b863.png[/img]
[h3]b) Oilrig[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/cd5ed11e6b335c4661a0098d4564579d88a97ac1.png[/img]
An old oil rig where workers once extracted oil from the depths of the Earth. When the apocalypse hit, unfinished maintenance work had to be abandoned, and the miners left all their valuable equipment behind in panic. 

Look around carefully and find a way to the abandoned loot, but be cautious! This structure doesn't seem very stable! To reach the top, the player will need to show both cleverness and quick reflexes, as the path to the reward is not obvious and will require some thought and the use of unconventional solutions in certain stages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/57d5a57c09ed58fde5980d2237e2cb7bc6215d74.png[/img]
[h3]c) Hunting Spot [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/4c47a884733215fc6240e8ebc4d6c18df37be74d.png[/img]
Originally prepared for hunting wildlife, these locations are now abandoned and repurposed to protect the property of former camp residents. Look around carefully; in this location, a keen eye could be worth its weight in gold!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/e71decd96bb080699aa424cd20cb8584412b773a.png[/img]
[h1]Wrap up![/h1]

Yes, we're all about action and your engagement. We emphasise teamwork but also friendly competition. In Survival Machine, you and your crew can collaborate to solve challenges together, but if you need an extra challenge, there's nothing stopping you from seeing who's the most agile and who can reach the reward hidden at the very top first. It's your choice, but survival is key 🙂

Thanks for your attention, as always, we're eager to hear your feedback, whether here on Steam or on our Discord! See you next time for the next Devlog!

notes.title: Introducing the Frontier!
notes.notes:
[h1]1. Intro[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/cb5f753a5ebabe7db8360ed0f236455ee8f9f9ce.png[/img]
Welcome all Survivors! It's time for another devlog from Survival Machine! Today's devlog, I'd like to dedicate almost entirely to our initial biome, the place where everything will begin for you, dear player.

Each biome, and we have three, is characterised by different terrain features, influencing the diversity and difficulty of moving from one point to another. 

The Alpine biome  has significantly more challenging terrain to explore. It is narrower but much higher, allowing for exploration upwards. 

The Desert is our largest biome. It is abundant in sandy islands that conceal various secrets, and the path to them is often not obvious.

 But lets leave those two biomes for another log, because [b]today is all about Frontier.[/b]

[h1]2. Frontier[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/fea553e32e11817fef44d3e8714789f701711242.png[/img]
Before your eyes, there will be open areas full of trees and beautiful vistas. The starting biome is the perfect place to learn the rules of Survival Machine. It's here where you'll encounter our zombies for the first time, and it's in the Frontier where you'll take your first steps towards the great adventure. 

[quote=author][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/9163688dbc6480d806c36d7b9715ec841679a4e5.png[/img]
Once an important gathering point for the local community, today, an abandoned ruin. But perhaps something inside has been preserved?[/quote]
This is also where the twilight of human civilization is most visible. Abandoned cowboy saloons, once mighty drilling platforms, and quaint farms now stand forgotten and deserted. From a thriving civilization, only abandoned buildings reminiscent of the past lives of local residents remain. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/dbbba551de3e81a83aa836b1dfcdc1796148420b.png[/img]
Frontier have a simple, though varied terrain, with plenty of trees that can be used as building material for your base on the Machine. Most paths to POIs (Points of Interest) are straightforward, with threats visible from afar. Here, the difficulty level of zombies increases with distance from the road, meaning the closer to the road, the safer it is. Players can find many caves and secrets here (I’ll explain secrets later in the log).

[h1]3. World’s structure[/h1]
Your adventure in each biome may never end; it all depends on your style of play and willingness to explore each of the worlds. The Machine and you leave the biome when you are ready. While driving forward you will simply return to previously visited areas after some time. It is your choice as a player to undertake a task of moving to the next biome or if you prefer to stay where you are, uncovering secrets, gathering resources, or simply exploring the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/b0e619dfaf6cd141941fa63251d63b23f3352cb0.png[/img]
Even if you were eager to explore a certain location, but your Machine departed long ago and just the smoke from the running engine is visible, don't worry. You can also stop and control the speed of the machine to make sure you have as much time as you need to explore the world.

[h1]4. Replayability[/h1]

[quote=author][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/e8a37727d50c474b89130802b076f7d4fc6ad57d.png[/img]
                                    [i]             Nice hunting spot just by the bridge…[/i][/quote]
Our world is changing some of its parts with each visit. Even if you've been to a certain area before, it doesn't mean you've seen everything. Do you think you know where the stone deposits are in this region because you've been here before? Sorry partner, not this time! Loots & Resources will appear in different parts of the world with each visit.

[quote=author][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/cf86b3fa1f1cc14d10ee8667d087a08f31eef3a9.png[/img]
  [i]             … but other time you’ll encounter an oil rig[/i][/quote]
The world we explore looks different each time, thanks to the system of randomly generated Points of Interest (POIs), which challenge players with various mechanics - from platforming and searching for routes to solving puzzles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/595ecd34a9bab0b386f3a5713bde3a695092166c.png[/img]
If the player has previously dealt with a roadblock, the next time they explore that area, they can focus strictly on searching for treasures or uncovering the secrets of that particular blockage.

[h1]5. Secrets[/h1]

You can pass by them hundreds of times, bypass hidden caves, trapdoors, or levers and not have a clue about it. We've hidden them very well. That's why I emphasise so strongly that exploring our world is important. We put them there for you to have a thrill of discovery just like Lewis and Clark, famous explorers who reached the coast of the Pacific in the early XIX century.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/51c252c9fdfb675cf5e824f6ec8968cbc693f365.jpg[/img]
Secrets aren't just a hidden chest, but the entire history of a place and sometimes an unexpected solution to get there. Secrets are also a random part of the world, so you might come across a secret once and not another time.

The better you know the world, the greater the chance of discovering secrets, and in them... oh wait, hold on. I can't tell you that. So dig deep, explore, discover and investigate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/ffb77a015ca168eadae9abdb0e28208205ca4dec.gif[/img]

[h1]6.  Wrap up[/h1]

That's all I've prepared for you this time. I hope you enjoyed our first biome. We put a lot of effort into making it the best introduction to the Survival Machine world possible. Rich in resources, open, easy to traverse, and interesting to explore—that's exactly what our Frontier is supposed to be. As always, we greatly value your feedback, so please let us know in the comments what you think!

notes.title: Behold... meet the mighty Machine!
notes.notes:
⠀⠀     [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/3169948cc77b63e99ed6d72696ac36bf58e23210.gif[/img]

[h1]Introduction[/h1]
Hi Survivors!

I can't believe it's been a month since our first DevLog, and remembering the promise we made to improve communication, we'd like to show you the next stage of work on the Survival Machine! What to expect from today’s read? Let us introduce you to The Machine! 

I'd like to emphasize that what you're going to see will certainly undergo some changes, but I'm still curious about your reaction and opinion on our progress. We think things are moving in the right direction, but there's always room for improvement and implementation of feedback!

So let me introduce you to… The Machine.

[h1]The Machine[/h1]

⠀       ⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/f573eba8c358783f5ae99d1682e1ab82e7b7eafe.gif[/img]
The machine is crucial. Without it, there's no chance of survival and reaching the last bastion of humanity. For every Survivor, the well-being of their Machine should be paramount because its demise also means the end of the adventure.

So how do I make this colossus do its thing? There are a few things you need to keep an eye on if you want your Machine to run smoothly. First of all…
 
[h2]Fuel[/h2]

Fuel! Such a giant requires significant amounts of energy to exist, and the heart of the Machine is our furnace. Remember, its depths are forever hungry! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/bbfff9cf9bbfbad1f3950fedc10d7fc72e362b2f.png[/img]

Our furnace can digest different fuel types, but some resources work better than others. Coal and other high-calorie resources will ensure a smooth ride for a longer time but are a touch harder to get.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/b6fdcad122fefd76aab999486836c26d5ecb111c.gif[/img]
Fuel enables resource processing which allows you to change basic resources into more advanced crafting materials. 

[h2]Resource processing[/h2]

So how do I make a rope for example? The process is straightforward but not necessarily simple. First, you need to gather resources for components to make thick cloth (3 units of cloth and 1 unit of fabric scrap). 

All of the basic materials you can find in our world, you just have to look carefully. When you have your ingredients, bring them back to the resource processing station and make sure there’s fuel in the Machine. No fuel, no resource processing. 

Once you’re able to make 3 units of thick cloth just add some plant fibre and… viola! You just made a rope!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/32ada10bb86c355485f61134e430d0767ded4305.gif[/img]
[h2]Sonar[/h2]

Very useful, you know? The technology is very new and still a little shaky but it will help you orient yourself in the Survival Machine world.

What information can you extract using your sonar? First of all your in-game friends. Thanks to this latest technological achievement not only you’ll be able to locate your friends on the map but also discover resources and blueprints to unlock new technology. 

Also! What if you need to pinpoint a position for your mate to go and find some resources? Sonar is very handy then because it can shoot up a visible flare from miles around. But remember! The sonar works only while the Machine is on the move!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/386f27aedac90145615cab852955b9cad72bef0f.png[/img]
[h2]Machine upgrades[/h2]

With time spent in Survival Machine, you'll quickly find out that your Machine is not at its peak power. But worry not! You’ll have an abundance of opportunities to upgrade your machine and make it a truly unstoppable force to be reckoned with.

Don't get me wrong, the Machine is a powerful tool just as it is, but progress and further development help immensely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/d03facd3f716f37b9fa5707647b6cac7653fe835.gif[/img]
But how does it make your life easier? With each subsequent upgrade of the Machine, its power increases. This allows for faster processing of needed materials. But not only that! You can increase the speed of your Machine and make it harder for zombies to climb.

⠀⠀     [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/b22bd9a2c331be42e2bd590cfd574437285dcaa4.gif[/img]

Look at how the interior of our machine room, the heart of our Machine, is going to change throughout the game. A new engine room = a faster and more powerful machine, thanks to which you can create increasingly advanced designs.

[h2]Map[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/61ce2b2aae0eac4d1685c549d5c4011fb03a00cc.gif[/img]
You'll start in a biome with a moderate climate, a world full of beautiful forests, abandoned saloons, and other structures testifying to the once-thriving civilization. But there’s more in the Survival Machine world! 

You can travel to an alpine region where the snow never melts or to the scorching desert where bones lie for vultures to feast on (although we have no vultures in our game but you get my point, right?). In order to travel through the biomes you need to upgrade your Machine.

[h1]Wrap up[/h1]

Thank you very much for taking a moment to read our second vlog. I hope it has somewhat clarified how your Machine will work and what you can expect from it. 

As always, I encourage you to leave a comment with your feedback, suggestions, and ratings. And of course, don't forget to join our community on Discord and add our game to your wishlist! See you at the next Devlog.

notes.title: The gears of development are moving!!
notes.notes:
⠀⠀⠀ [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/150065b0d0110f11a81f8434d572ac8c33e63f0d.gif[/img]

[h1]1. Intro[/h1]

[u][b]Hello Survivors![/b][/u] 

We're excited to share that we're kicking off development logs to keep you in the loop about our progress. We know it's been a while since we communicated with you. We want to apologise for that and what’s more important: we want to change that. Expect to find details about what's coming up, content updates, progress GIFs, photos, and sneak peeks into our (not-so) future plans. Stay tuned for some insights into our development journey!
[h1]2. Our path until today[/h1]

To help us get funding, we have created a trailer to showcase our vision. Its success helped us find a publisher, secure funding, and start the initial development phase [i](I was there Gandalf…[/i]). That was a big thing for us as we could concentrate on what we really wanted to do - a fun game we all could enjoy. 
We were filled with joy and a sense of purpose. Unfortunately, after the pre-production, the publisher had to step back due to industry crises. As you can imagine that was a huge blow and step-back for us and we were very close to wrapping the whole thing up.

However! Thanks to the funding we acquired later, we're now in a solid position to persist with development and actively seek out a new partner for our project.	

[h1]3. What to expect from Survival Machine?[/h1]

We know what game we want to build. We're excited to start sharing our game concept with you! We want to highlight the game’s mood, style and features that define Survival Machine. Here are some of the pillars of our gameplay:
[list][*]We’re creating a[b] [u]lighthearted survival-adventure game[/u][/b] centred around exploration and fighting zombies
[*]The game is about the journey of the machine and you alongside it
[*]At its essence, the game has been made to deliver a fun experience, especially when played with friends (up to 4 players)
[*]There are multiple playstyles available, in combat and in gathering resources
[*]Approach it with a good sense of humour—it's designed to be enjoyed with a wink and not taking itself too seriously.[/list][h1]4. Features[/h1]

Consider this as our first iteration—just a little peek into the evolving world of Survival Machine we're creating. Although the game development has been ongoing for over a year now, not everything is set in stone.
